patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: (rousable only briefly) ...I'm fine... just tired... please don't call my office...
presentation.triageNote: 46-year-old female found drowsy at her desk with empty zolpidem and lorazepam packets nearby; rousable to voice and protecting her own airway.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because a suspected mixed sedative overdose with significant drowsiness, respiratory rate 11, and bradycardia is high risk despite preserved airway protection.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient is rousable but markedly sedated beside empty sedative medication packets.
clinical.acuityReason: Her airway is currently protected, yet mixed sedatives can cause progressive respiratory depression and cannot safely wait for routine resource sorting.
expectedResources: Bedside glucose, ECG, and toxicologic assessment
teachingPoints: Clothing, occupation, or social appearance does not change overdose risk.
Flumazenil is not routinely safe in unknown or mixed overdoses because it can precipitate seizures.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Close respiratory observation and supportive care would continue until sustained recovery, with psychiatric assessment when ingestion intent is clarified.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 46-year-old woman in a smart tailored blazer and blouse, slumped back on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: slumped back with head lolling to one side, arms limp at her sides
signs: an immaculate blazer at odds with her posture
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: deeply drowsy but breathing on her own
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 46-year-old woman in a smart tailored blazer and blouse, slumped back on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: slumped back with head lolling to one side, arms limp at her sides. Expression: heavy-lidded and barely rousable. Clearly visible: eyes half closed; an immaculate blazer at odds with her posture; slack facial muscles. Overall: deeply drowsy but breathing on her own. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
